title: Observability failure cartography and early-warning hub
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: build an integrated failure cartography (visual map of failure modes) and an early-warning hub that ties tracing hooks, enriched metrics/log pipelines, and a set of latency/error dashboards into actionable alerts and runbooks. Goals: (1) classify and tag failure events reliably at ingest (timeouts, overload/backpressure, model rejections/invalid outputs, client HTTP/gRPC error codes, infra OOMs), (2) provide per-route and per-model dashboards with fast pivots by failure class, deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), and tenant, (3) wire alerts to an early-warning hub that surfaces likely-incidents before SLO breaches, with automated suggested remediation playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Tracehook library emits standardized failure tags (failure.class, failure.subclass, failure.source) for 95% of observed error traces. 2) Metrics pipeline enriches errors with model_id, route, deployment_tier and failure.class at aggregation time. 3) Dashboards include: Failure Map (heatmap by route x failure.class), Top-2 latency root cause drilldown, and Time-to-Detection for early-warning alerts. 4) Pager/ops routing rules created for high-impact failure classes; runbooks linked. 5) Performance impact: trace sampling and enrichment must not add more than 3% p50 latency and must preserve our ingest budget.
design_decisions: Use a lightweight tracehook shim in the runtime to attach failure tags at the earliest point of detection rather than post-hoc log parsing
Enrich spans with canonical failure.class values: timeout, overload, model_error, protocol_error, infra_resource, client_error
Propagate failure.subclass for more detailed downstream filtering (e.g., timeout.network, timeout.kv-cache, overload.queue-depth, model_error.invalid-output)
Metrics pipeline will compute per-minute aggregated counters and 99/95 latency histograms keyed by (route, model_id, failure.class) in the OLAP layer

Alerting will be tiered: early-warning (anomaly above baseline for failure.class with low volume) -> validation (rate-based threshold) -> incident (SLO breach). Early-warning uses rolling z-score on enrichment signals
Dashboard UX: lean landing page with service map, a guided pivot for on-call to run the targeted runbook in two clicks
work_items: Implement tracehook shim in serving runtime and expose failure tags to tracing headers (ENG-runtime-branch PR forthcoming)
Add enrichment stage in metrics pipeline to backfill model_id and route from trace IDs when missing
Build Grafana Failure Map panel and a lightweight pivot widget for on-call
Create prometheus metrics and OLAP aggregations for failure.class buckets
Author runbooks for timeout, overload, and model_error with remediation steps and rollbacks
Integrate early-warning alerts into PagerDuty escalation with playbook links
